legend: Riana got really bored one day and decided to play with some integers. She started with the positive integer N$$$N$$$. She then noticed that N$$$N$$$ was too small and boring. Suddenly, she got the idea to create a really big integer. To do so, she multiplied all of the positive divisors of N$$$N$$$ and got the integer M$$$M$$$. After getting the value of M$$$M$$$, she challenged her friend Cisco to determine the value of the original integer N$$$N$$$ given M$$$M$$$. Help Cisco find the value of N$$$N$$$.
input: The input contains one line containing the integer M$$$M$$$. It is guaranteed that M$$$M$$$ is a positive integer less than 1015$$$10^{15}$$$.
output: Output the original integer N$$$N$$$ if possible. Otherwise, output −1$$$-1$$$.
note: In the first test case, the positive divisors of 4 are 1, 2, and 4. The product is 8.
In the second test case, there is no integer whose product of its positive divisors is 4.
